_comment: 🧩️ This subset's contribution to the repository test platform: the exhaustive mutation vocabulary of WAV RIFF-PCM's `any` subset and the reference oracle that proves each kind against `hound`. The shared stdio manifest already registers `hound` under capability `wave-audio` for the older creation/retune case — that capability is not `…-mutate`, so this subset registers its own oracle entry under a distinct id and capability rather than reusing it (reusing would fail the contract with `oracle-capability-mismatch`).

oracles.rationale: The reference RIFF/PCM WAVE reader/writer of the Rust ecosystem, used here as the independent implementation for every declared mutation kind of the `any` subset: the fmt/data pair is decoded and re-encoded through hound itself, and only the RIFF chunk *framing* hound has no concept of (arbitrary non-fmt/non-data chunks) is spliced by hand — the same fixed 8-byte fourcc+size wire header the format itself defines, not an interpretive choice this oracle is making on hound's behalf.
